Coordination/Actor.description: Typed attribution. Concrete actor identity is authenticated by the accepted Timeline protocol; naming it confers no permission.
Coordination/Actor.name: Coordination/Actor

Coordination/Actor Policy.description: Per-operation Actor/Source restrictions. A known Marker interpreted by the Timeline authority runtime; it performs no business mutation.
Coordination/Actor Policy.name: Coordination/Actor Policy

Coordination/Agent Actor.description: Explicit automation attribution. The actor remains distinct from a represented holder; no delegation is implied.
Coordination/Agent Actor.name: Coordination/Agent Actor

activationEntry.description: Optional Coordination/Timeline Entry; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

Coordination/Attachment.description: Exact consumer attachment lifetime. generation distinguishes removal/recreation. cutoff is frozen at attachment; initialized source history must still be established from its beginning.
Coordination/Attachment.name: Coordination/Attachment

source.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

Coordination/Authority.description: A claim to exercise the authority of the named actor; must be verified by its concrete authority protocol.
Coordination/Authority.name: Coordination/Authority

Coordination/Browser Session Source.description: Provider-authenticated interactive submission context. It is not proof of human presence beyond the concrete provider assertion.
Coordination/Browser Session Source.name: Coordination/Browser Session Source

Coordination/Document Epoch.description: A stable document revision. Its history position is exact; epoch alone is not enough to select a history.

document.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

documentId.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

Coordination/Document Epoch.name: Coordination/Document Epoch

Coordination/Document Request Source.description: Provider-authenticated provenance from a real document request occurrence, not a copied request value.
Coordination/Document Request Source.name: Coordination/Document Request Source

Coordination/Emitted Occurrence.description: One output occurrence. Equal-content events retain distinct zero-based ordinals in the same source receipt.

event.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

Coordination/Emitted Occurrence.name: Coordination/Emitted Occurrence

Coordination/Entry Assessment.description: Feeder outcome for one exact entry and receiving channel/lifetime. It is evidence to verify, not a user-authored permission token.

document.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

mandatePosition.description: Optional Coordination/History Position; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

Coordination/Entry Assessment.name: Coordination/Entry Assessment

Coordination/Event.description: A typed application event; its content does not establish an emission occurrence.
Coordination/Event.name: Coordination/Event

Coordination/History Position.description: One append-only processing or receiving-history position. position increments for retained transitions; epoch counts completed stable revisions. A catch-up position may retain the prior stable epoch.

document.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

documentId.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

effectiveEntry.description: Optional Coordination/Timeline Entry; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

Coordination/History Position.name: Coordination/History Position

Coordination/Managed Document State.description: Optional read-model value; not part of business content. Public handles and account/lease fields remain host metadata.

issue.description: Optional Coordination/Processing Issue; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

lastStable.description: Optional Coordination/Document Epoch; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

Coordination/Managed Document State.name: Coordination/Managed Document State

after.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

Coordination/Member Result.description: One owned member projection of a complete result. before is absent for a genuine new member. No account identifiers belong in this content.

documentId.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

Coordination/Member Result.name: Coordination/Member Result

Coordination/Message.description: An addressed application message; addressing does not confer confidentiality.
Coordination/Message.name: Coordination/Message

Coordination/Order Key.description: Canonical external position. Compare timestamp numerically, then canonical Timeline and entry identity text as unsigned ASCII bytes.
Coordination/Order Key.name: Coordination/Order Key

Coordination/Principal Actor.description: A directly attributed principal in a provider authority domain. accountId is not proof of authentication.
Coordination/Principal Actor.name: Coordination/Principal Actor

Coordination/Processing Issue.description: A concise explained wait/error. Resource identity and diagnostics are subject to the reader access policy.
Coordination/Processing Issue.name: Coordination/Processing Issue

Coordination/Processing Proof.description: Replay package index, not a proof-admission shortcut. Contains enough actual content, complete source ranges, authority histories and lower-runtime evidence to verify its target.

initialDocument.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

Coordination/Processing Proof.name: Coordination/Processing Proof

runtimeEvidence.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

throughEntry.description: Optional Coordination/Timeline Entry; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

after.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

before.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

Coordination/Processing Receipt.description: Canonical completed computation claim, distinct from variable proof material or host commit. kind determines required cause fields under the specification. Source applications never re-execute the source operation.

documentId.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

event.description: Optional Coordination/Timeline Entry; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

Coordination/Processing Receipt.name: Coordination/Processing Receipt

Coordination/Request.description: A request emitted by a document. Its legitimate committed occurrence, not copied content, is relevant to external execution.
Coordination/Request.name: Coordination/Request

Coordination/Response.description: A response to one exact Request.
Coordination/Response.name: Coordination/Response

Coordination/Signed Timeline.description: A concrete Ed25519 chained source. Strictly increasing timestamps. Its key authenticates provider attribution and closed-prefix assertions.
Coordination/Signed Timeline.name: Coordination/Signed Timeline

Coordination/Source.description: Provider-authenticated submission provenance: how an input was submitted. Not a Timeline provider locator.
Coordination/Source.name: Coordination/Source

Coordination/Timeline.description: An immutable source identifier and the protocol under which its provider accepts and proves entries.
Coordination/Timeline.name: Coordination/Timeline

Coordination/Timeline Attestation.description: Ed25519 provider authentication of an exact guarantee. Verify the signature over the fixed domain plus guarantee BlueId, and bind all enumerated predecessors to its lastEntry.
Coordination/Timeline Attestation.name: Coordination/Timeline Attestation

Coordination/Timeline Channel.description: Inputs from this Timeline for this actor. A supported deterministic runtime consumes exact preverified eligibility, preserves the original event, and observes global-order progress rather than timestamp-only delegated freshness.
Coordination/Timeline Channel.name: Coordination/Timeline Channel

Coordination/Timeline Completeness Guara.description: Provider assertion: no later acceptance can add an entry below completeBefore. lastEntry is the last entry inside that closed prefix; its absence positively asserts an empty prefix.
Coordination/Timeline Completeness Guara.name: Coordination/Timeline Completeness Guarantee

Coordination/Timeline Entry.description: Original immutable accepted input. message and immediate operation identify the same Operation Request when present. prevEntry is per-Timeline. Evidence never rewrites the event.

message.description: Required exact content operand. Presence is checked by the protocol verifier; the addressed document may be an unvalued definition or a program with no business fields.

Coordination/Timeline Entry.name: Coordination/Timeline Entry

onBehalfOf.description: Optional Coordination/Authority; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

operation.description: Optional Contracts/Operation Request; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

source.description: Optional Coordination/Source; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

Coordination/Timeline Range Evidence.description: A contiguous ordered enumeration anchored at a previously verified predecessor or at genesis, ending at the guarantee head. Absence of after means genesis. A page is not this complete record.
Coordination/Timeline Range Evidence.name: Coordination/Timeline Range Evidence

Mandate/Approved.description: Owner approval of the exact authority program.
Mandate/Approved.name: Mandate/Approved

Mandate/Document Validation.description: Static actual-target pattern and optional read-only BEX predicate. Both checks apply.
Mandate/Document Validation.name: Mandate/Document Validation

$failIf.message: Only a Pending Mandate can be approved.
Approval must pin the reviewed exact document.

Mandate/Mandate.description: Owner-approved authority program. No mandatory guarantor. Genuine approval history and protected base lifecycle are enforced by the feeder protocol.
Mandate/Mandate.name: Mandate/Mandate

Mandate/Mandate Authority.description: Entry-level delegation claim. Initial Mandate reference, real submitting actor and represented holder remain distinct.
Mandate/Mandate Authority.name: Mandate/Mandate Authority

Mandate/Operation Grant.description: One complete alternative permission. All target and request checks in this same grant must pass.
Mandate/Operation Grant.name: Mandate/Operation Grant

documentValidation.description: Optional Mandate/Document Validation; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

validation.description: Optional Mandate/Request Validation; validate exact type ancestry when supplied.

Mandate/Operation Mandate.description: An owner-approved Mandate whose typed current scope grants several operations, potentially on different documents. The same initial Mandate reference is used throughout.
Mandate/Operation Mandate.name: Mandate/Operation Mandate

Mandate/Request Validation.description: Static actual-request pattern and optional read-only BEX predicate. Both checks apply.
Mandate/Request Validation.name: Mandate/Request Validation

Mandate/Status.description: Lifecycle of owner-approved authority. Active never means independently guaranteed.
Mandate/Status.name: Mandate/Status

Mandate/Terminated.description: Permanent end of this delegation; prior valid business transitions remain valid.
Mandate/Terminated.name: Mandate/Terminated

Mandate/Termination Requested.description: Request to the base lifecycle, not an external authorization shortcut.
Mandate/Termination Requested.name: Mandate/Termination Requested
